Naked and afraid

By: Tarryn Crossman | Paid

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
He is the first South African to ever successfully complete the hit reality tv show Naked and Africa

Further information:
This is the story about the reality of reality TV, Warrick is the only South African to ever finish naked and afraid. He survived 21 days naked in an extremely remote part of Zambia, but at what cost?

At one point he was so food-deprived and delirious that he swam into the Zambezi river to catch a crocodile, unable to get involved the camera crew just let him go and dropped in for the shot.
Every 2nd day he wanted to tap out and go home to his wife and 3-month-old baby, but his partner on the reality show needed him to stay, he was also using his own handmade crossbow and didn’t want the whole world to think the crossbow failed him, as making these crossbows is his lively hood. On top of it all, he had always wanted to be on this show and his ego wouldn’t let him quit.

When the 21 days were up he hiked for seven hours to the escape car and that’s when the hardest part of the journey began.
Warrick’s wife laura says she thought she had lost her husband forever. “he had become emotionally withdrawn, he was hiding food and was painfully underweight. I didn’t know how to talk to him anymore” Laura

It took 6 months for Warrick to physically and mentally recover from the reality show.
Almost a year later he has now been contacted to participate in a naked and afraid XL challenge which is 40 days, but after suffering PTSD and becoming so physically sick from the first show he is doubtful he will do it again.
